sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_date" TEXT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "include_in_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_total" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4284773515, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("kind", "system_key"), CHECK (system_key IS NOT NULL OR name IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_date" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NULL, "time_of_day_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 720, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income', 'transfer')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NULL, "attachment_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attachments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_ref_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (to_account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (to_account_id IS NULL OR to_account_id <> account_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_migrations" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("version"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "warn_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "notify" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "last_alert" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK (warn_percent BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (period <> 'custom' OR (start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= start_date)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_categories" ("budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES budgets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transaction_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("budget_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "due_time_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "minutes_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (minutes_before >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "next_due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind_days_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "remind_at_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 540, "reminders_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminders_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK (remind_days_before >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("bill_id", "due_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "estimated_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "actual_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "is_purchased" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_purchased" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (quantity_milli > 0), CHECK (estimated_price_minor IS NULL OR estimated_price_minor >= 0), CHECK (actual_price_minor IS NULL OR actual_price_minor >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "target_date" TEXT NULL, "linked_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'savings', "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4279673674, "remind_monthly" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind_monthly" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_amount_minor > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES savings_goals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR', "interest_rate_bps" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "disbursement_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "settled_at" TEXT NULL, "remind_days_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "reminders_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminders_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (principal_minor > 0), CHECK (interest_rate_bps IS NULL OR interest_rate_bps >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "loan_repayments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "loan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES loans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "principal_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "interest_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "principal_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "interest_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (principal_minor >= 0 AND interest_minor >= 0), CHECK (principal_minor + interest_minor > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'star', "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4279150057, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (target_count BETWEEN 1 AND 99));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("habit_id", "date"), CHECK (count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "remind_days_before" INTEGER NULL, "remind_at_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 540, "budget_minor" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (budget_minor IS NULL OR budget_minor >= 0));
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_kind ON transaction_categories (kind)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_local_date ON transactions (local_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_to_account ON transactions (to_account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_type_date ON transactions (type, local_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_recurring ON transactions (recurring_rule_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_due ON tasks (is_completed, due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_bills_due ON bills (is_active, next_due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_bill_payments_bill ON bill_payments (bill_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_shopping_items_list ON shopping_items (list_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_savings_movements_goal ON savings_movements (goal_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_loan_repayments_loan ON loan_repayments (loan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_habit_logs_date ON habit_logs (habit_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date ON personal_events (date)
